shortcut_name: exact independent-set witness with early acceptance
evidence: The survivor uses "order vertices by degree (small to large) for better pruning" and searches for a result of size k rather than enumerating all valid arrays.
affordance_in_statement: If an interference-free broadcast array of exactly k channels exists, print YES ... Any array in which no two channels conflict is accepted.
removal_suggestion: This cannot be removed without changing the required witness problem or its acceptance rule. The only practical alternative is to re-present the scenario as requiring adversarial worst-case conflict graphs and target sizes that prevent early witnesses and weak pruning.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses an exact bitmask backtracking search with degree ordering and branch-and-bound, stopping as soon as any independent set of size k is found.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Any array in which no two channels conflict is accepted.

common_affordance: The task accepts any independent-set witness of exactly k vertices, allowing branch-and-bound to terminate on the first witness instead of solving a canonical or optimization version.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its meet-in-the-middle implementation materializes all independent subsets of a half in a Python list, causing excessive memory use and a runtime error on large or sparse instances.
It enumerates every k-combination and checks conflicts directly, giving exponential combination count and timing out near n=46.

It uses a one-pass greedy selection and does not backtrack, so it is not complete for deciding whether an independent set of size k exists; its output handling also fails on cases where the greedy prefix is insufficient.

recommended_edit: No semantics-preserving wording edit can reliably defeat the surviving exact solver. If a single practical edit is allowed, add to the scenario that test data includes adversarial near-half-target conflict graphs specifically chosen to defeat early witnesses and degree-based pruning, while leaving the input and output formats unchanged.
